about.title: About Le Canot à Pixels
about.lead: Buying and selling retro video games, rooted in Lavaltrie, Québec.
about.storyBody: Le Canot à Pixels ("the pixel canoe") takes its name from the {legendLink}, still very much alive in Lavaltrie: a flying canoe that carried lumberjacks home in a single night. Here, the canoe carries something else: retro video games that get back into play instead of sleeping in a box in the basement.
about.buyBody: Got retro video games collecting dust? We buy them, single titles or whole lots. Check the wanted games list or write to us with what you have: we look at everything and reply quickly, with fair offers.
about.sellBody: Every game we put up for sale is tested, and its listing details what comes with it: disc, case, manual. The price is clearly shown, so there are no surprises once you get home. Photos show the actual item whenever possible; otherwise a reference cover is displayed and clearly flagged.
about.sourceBody: Core information (title, console, reference value, condition) is imported from PriceCharting. Site-specific statuses, sale prices and notes are managed locally.
about.disclaimerBody: The values shown are reference values from the imported data. They give an idea of the market, but they are not a price guarantee.
